text:
priya: ok team — planning the launch comms for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. want a short cadence for launch posts, a webinar hook, and inbound routing rules. goal: clear product differentiation + lead qualification flow.

alex: agree. can we run 3-week pre, launch day, 2-week post cadence?

maya: +1. suggested messaging angles: Hosted = fastest time-to-value, Dedicated = committed throughput & SLA, Private = security/compliance. keep 1 line hero per page, then 2 bullets.

tom: visuals note — hero should show latency/cost tradeoff matrix, small 3-col layout for the three modes. I can mock by Friday.

ken: for inbound routing: marketing leads for hosted trial, AE outreach for dedicated commits, enterprise ops for private. want qualification fields: expected qps, data residency, compliance reqs.

priya: nice. draft cadence (very rough):
```
week -3: teaser post (benchmark highlight + webinar announce)
week -1: deeper post (use case playbooks + signup)
day 0: launch post + hero page live + email to active leads
week +1: webinar (benchmarks + migration stories)
week +2: followups + nurture flows
```

alex: for benchmark highlight — can we use 3 short vignettes: startup integrating hosted, mid-market scaling to dedicated, regulated customer on private. each vignette one metric (latency, cost delta, compliance time).

maya: love the vignettes. I'll write 3 hero lines to test in A/B:
- Hosted hero: "Ship LLM features fast — hosted inference with predictable latency."
- Dedicated hero: "Predictable throughput, enterprise SLAs — reserved GPU pools for production."
- Private hero: "Keep data in your control — VPC & on-prem inference with audit logs."

tom: sample sub-bullets for each:
- Hosted: instant API keys, streaming, built-in caching
- Dedicated: autoscale, burst capacity, model pinning
- Private: KMS/HSM, air-gap option, compliance templates

ken: routing matrix idea: add a 3-field form on signup: avg requests/day, data sensitivity (low/medium/high), contract length desired. then map to: hosted trial / self-serve docs => Hosted, SDR handoff => Dedicated, Enterprise AE + Security sync => Private.

priya: perfect. webinar hook draft: "Real production LLMs: how teams cut latency and cost without sacrificing safety" — bench cases + a short panel on migrations. 45min + 15min q&a.

alex: promo post copy idea (short): "Benchmark: same prompts, 3 deployment modes — cost & latency compared. Register for the webinar to see migration paths." link to sign-up. add :bar_chart: emoji.

maya: CTA map for pages:
- Hosted hero CTA: "Start free trial" -> routes to trial funnel (capture basic fields)
- Dedicated CTA: "Talk to sales" -> routes to AE queue + prequal form
- Private CTA: "Request private demo" -> routes to security-led intake + legal ops loop

priya: quick copy polish ask — can we make Hosted hero less "marketing-y". keep it developer-forward. e.g., "Get an API that scales with your app — start in minutes."

alex: also recommend a small benchmark snippet under each hero: one metric line (p50 latency, $/1M tokens, compliance level). keeps comparison concrete.

tom: i'll drop the mockup with sample metric bars and the routing microcopy by EOD Friday.

maya: i'll push updated landing copy variants to the doc: hosted_v1/hosted_v2 etc and add test plan for 2 weeks A/B.

ken: i'll add the inbound form mapping to the CRM so routing is automated. will need the exact fields by Thursday.

webinar-bot: reminder set — webinar scheduled for 2026-04-14 10:00 PT. registration page created: https://events.redwood.ai/webinar-llm-production

priya: next steps: maya write copy + vignettes (Tue), tom mockups (Fri), ken map CRM fields (Thu), alex prep benchmark data (Mon). I'll consolidate launch post drafts and send for review on Tuesday am. thanks :raised_hands:

alex: smashing. one last ask — include a short FAQ on Private page about deployment time + support SLA. sales gets that asked a lot.

maya: noted. adding FAQ bullets: timeline, infra requirements, compliance checklist.

priya: great. closing this thread — ping me if blockers.
